boundary.description: From Kittlingbourne Bridge over the M6 at junction 30 at Prospect Hill, S by M61 to junction 9 at a point adjacent to the junction of Clayton Brook Road and Great Green Lane, NW crossing the A6 following the River Lostock on the N side of Riverside and Holme Road, SW crossing A6 to Stone Bridge, N at Todd Lane South to Todd Lane North at Limekiln Cottage, E to corner of Charnley Fold and Cottage Lane to Kittlingbourne Bridge at Prospect Hill.

supplementaryNote.title: Area served from Liverpool Archdiocese
supplementaryNote.text: NW along the ‘greenway corridor’ (which marks the Salford Diocese – Liverpool Archdiocese boundary, formerly the Hundred of Blackburnshire) and which separates the following streets in Salford Diocese: Great Green Lane, Tunley Holme, School Field, Clayton Brook and most of Daisy Meadow, from the following streets in Liverpool Archdiocese: The Heathers, Well Orchard and part of Daisy Meadow, to a point where it meets Preston Road A6 at Clayton Brook SW by this brook and the Ribble-Chorley civic boundary to the River Lostock and NW across the complex junction of M6 and M65.
